title: Don't warn on dropped raw TeX that only defines macros Pandoc already expanded

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Pandoc expands macros defined in Markdown (\newcommand and similar) into the math that uses them, but still passes the definition itself as raw TeX. Quire drops that raw TeX and warned, so a document that does the right thing got a spurious "dropped raw TeX" warning (s12 architect finding G5).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: quire.py (convert_raw_tex and a small helper), test_render.py, README.md (Page breaks section), CHANGELOG.md

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: test_render.py: a definitions-only raw block (newcommand, renewcommand, providecommand, def, DeclareMathOperator) is dropped silently; a mixed block (definitions plus other TeX) still warns and names the non-definition command; non-definition TeX still warns.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: When a dropped raw TeX node contains only macro definitions (brace-balanced, recognized forms), drop it without recording a warning. Any other remainder still warns, naming the first command outside the definitions.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: python3 test_quire.py; black --check quire.py test_quire.py; flake8 quire.py test_quire.py

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Do not commit; orchestrator handles it.
